current_task_corrections.correction: Add the synthetic_data caveat to the report's Caveats section to explicitly disclose that the analysis uses synthetic data, affecting interpretation and applicability of findings.

reusable_lessons.lesson: When calculating denial rates by segment or other dimensions, use adjudicated claims (Paid, Denied, Adjusted) as the denominator. This establishes the correct statistical basis for segment-level rate comparison and operational decision-making, excluding unadjudicated claims.

Include a synthetic_data caveat in all reports when analyzing synthetic or simulated data. This disclosure is essential for readers to understand the data source and correctly interpret findings and their applicability to real-world scenarios.
